Young age. Not young ideas.

Most kids my age are consuming the internet. I'm building it. What started as curiosity about how websites work turned into an obsession with crafting interfaces that feel like science fiction — and work like science fact.

Today I design and build frontend experiences powered by AI: a browser that thinks with you, chatbots that actually understand, and UI systems with a cyberpunk soul.

// SYS.MODULE_05 → TIMELINE.LOG

The journey so far

2023 // FIRST CONTACT

Discovered code

Opened DevTools on a website out of curiosity. Changed a color. Watched the page change. Hooked forever.

2024 // SKILL GRIND

HTML → CSS → JS → React

Months of building bad websites on purpose. Every broken layout taught me something the tutorials didn't.

2025 // AI AWAKENING

Started building with AI

Built my first chatbot, then realized AI could live inside everything I designed — browsers, editors, UI itself.

2026 // PRESENT DAY

Building the future

Developing MyDaksha, the AI-supported browser, and designing interfaces that make the web feel like 2043.
